published_protocol_policy: max(50,ceil(all source-training pool images/2)) updates per round; uses the full source pool size, not only the labeled subset.
scopes: 1061catalogued model/view records,1043distinct original source-run metadata files; neither number is an independent-fit total or the entire upstream HPO grid.
Teacher1/ensemble views share training. Post-LoRA fresh-head rows omit the already trained parent stage from their own update count; do not treat them as a one-stage compute comparison.
Recorded label-image unions remove study-HPO overlap, but omit unknown pretraining membership and do not measure annotation time or mask-equivalent labor.
All original pause-contaminated raw timers remain preserved; no active-compute estimate or adjusted elapsed total is produced.
